paragraphs: StackBench develops custom mobile applications for law enforcement and government agencies. Clients are described as running from police departments to municipal bodies across the nation. One product line is named UCP For Police Departments.

The product broadcasts real-time information to citizens, covering road closures, active shooter situations, wrecks and events. Automated translation supports US English, Spanish and Vietnamese. Internal communication for police departments replaces pagers, memos, and email. Fire departments are addressed with internal communication that can be accessed from anywhere. Citizens can use customizable informational tabs covering Crime Trends, Most Wanted, and Zone Check Requests.

StackBench is a subsidiary of Confianz Global, Inc., and Anoop Menon is President and CEO. Ken Schul, a retired Captain from the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Department, serves as the Director at StackBench.

quote.text: Founded by a team of technology enthusiasts who deeply respect public service
